frontier.scope: Target-assisted response frontier for measured 0.90x/1.15x candidates and their actual bilinear delivery. Diagnostic, selects a point retrospectively.

forward_preview.scope: Interleaved proof while feature collection may share the GPU. Timing excludes source decode and model load.

idle_forward_preview.scope: Local 50k IEEE FP32. Three noise settings per batch of three crops. Encoder equality checked on every shared forward. Restore forward time excludes source decode, previews and setup.
